question: Which statement is true in relation to the term transcriptome ?:

options.opa: It includes all the transfer RNA generated from the genome of an organism.
options.opb: It includes all the messenger RNA that is generated from the genome of an organism.
options.opc: Includes products translated from the genome of an organism.
options.opd: It includes all types of RNA generated from the genome of an organism.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Transcriptome" -> "Includes all the messenger RNA that is generated from the genome of an organism" -> 95% CHAIN: "Transcriptome" -> "Includes products translated from the genome of an organism" -> 95%
analysis: The term transcriptome refers to the complete set of all RNA molecules, including messenger RNA (mRNA), transfer RNA (tRNA), ribosomal RNA (rRNA), and other non-coding RNA produced in one or a population of cells. It does not include products translated from the genome.
